properties.title: Severe latency on Postgres session store under peak load
properties.body: After profiling connection exhaustion on Postgres under peak user load, Alice Vance decided: Migrate session storage from Postgres to Redis cluster to eliminate database connection pool contention. System: Redis.

properties.title: Redis session cluster operational maintenance and failover complexity
properties.body: Given recurring operational failover complexity of standalone Redis clusters, Alice Vance decided: Migrate session storage to embedded Keycloak cache. This decision supersedes Migrate session storage from Postgres to Redis cluster. System: Keycloak.

properties.title: Slow analytical queries on historical clickstream datasets
properties.body: After evaluating data warehouse capacity for ad-hoc aggregations, Fiona Gallagher decided: Adopt Snowflake for analytics ETL queries to decouple reporting compute from transactional systems. System: Snowflake.

properties.title: High compute credits on daily analytics warehouse rollups
properties.body: Due to soaring cloud warehouse compute costs and 10x slower p95 reporting queries, Carlos Mendez decided: Migrate analytics reporting queries from Snowflake to ClickHouse cluster. This decision supersedes Adopt Snowflake for analytics ETL queries. System: ClickHouse.

properties.title: Need enterprise event bus for asynchronous order processing
properties.body: To guarantee strictly-ordered replayable message streams across our microservices, Alice Vance decided: Use Kafka for all event messaging across services. System: Kafka.

properties.title: Lightweight pubsub requirements for async background tasks
properties.body: To avoid heavy JVM JVM operational overhead and complex partition management for simple workers, Bob Martin decided: Use RabbitMQ for all event messaging across services. This decision contradicts Use Kafka for all event messaging across services. System: Kafka.

properties.title: Plaintext secret leakage risk in CI/CD pipeline variables
properties.body: Following an internal audit of credentials stored in build configurations, Diana Prince decided: Store secret credentials exclusively in HashiCorp Vault instead of Kubernetes secrets. System: Vault.

properties.title: Inconsistent distributed trace propagation in checkout services
properties.body: To enable end-to-end distributed transaction tracing with minimal agent configuration, Kevin Flynn decided: Standardize application traces on Datadog APM across all production services. System: Datadog.

properties.title: Cluster-wide metrics collection and automated alerts
properties.body: To achieve standardized Kubernetes metrics collection and alerting, Laura Croft decided: Deploy Prometheus Operator on all Kubernetes staging clusters. System: Prometheus.

properties.title: Memory pressure on legacy RabbitMQ broker during notifications spike
properties.body: After profiling message broker RAM usage during customer broadcast spikes, Ian Malcolm decided: Deprecate legacy RabbitMQ clusters in favor of native Redis PubSub for low-volume notifications. System: Redis.

properties.title: OAuth2 token issuance architecture for internal gateway
properties.body: To streamline microservice token validation and role-based access control, Julia Roberts decided: Use Keycloak OAuth2 tokens for internal API gateway authentication. System: Keycloak.

properties.title: Replication lag and connection pool contention on primary database
properties.body: To leverage native logical replication performance and query pipeline improvements, Evan Wright decided: Upgrade all production Postgres instances to version 16. System: Postgres.

properties.body:
Meeting: Q1 Infrastructure Kickoff
Date: 2026-01-15
Attended by: Alice Vance, Bob Martin, Laura Croft, Kevin Flynn
Notes: Reviewed OKRs for Q1. Focus will be on database connection stability and zero-trust auth groundwork.

properties.title: IAM Architecture Modernization
properties.body:
Meeting: IAM Architecture Modernization
Date: 2026-02-10
Attended by: Julia Roberts, Diana Prince, Alice Vance
Notes: Evaluated Okta, Auth0, and self-hosted Keycloak. Julia Roberts decided: Adopt Keycloak for company-wide single sign-on to comply with on-premise governance constraints. System: Keycloak.

properties.title: Data Platform Quarterly Review
properties.body:
Meeting: Data Platform Quarterly Review
Date: 2026-03-05
Attended by: Carlos Mendez, Fiona Gallagher, Nina Simone
Notes: Discussed expanding ETL streaming jobs and real-time dashboard latency requirements.

properties.title: Observability Platform Alignment
properties.body:
Meeting: Observability Platform Alignment
Date: 2026-04-12
Attended by: Kevin Flynn, Laura Croft, Diana Prince
Notes: Given escalating vendor licensing costs of proprietary APM tools, Kevin Flynn decided: Migrate application metrics from Datadog to Prometheus Operator. This decision supersedes Standardize application traces on Datadog APM across all production services. System: Prometheus.

properties.title: Core Messaging Architecture Sync
properties.body:
Meeting: Core Messaging Architecture Sync
Date: 2026-05-18
Attended by: Bob Martin, Alice Vance, Ian Malcolm
Notes: Re-evaluated messaging brokers for backend services. Bob Martin reiterated: Use RabbitMQ for all event messaging across services. This decision contradicts Use Kafka for all event messaging across services. System: RabbitMQ.

properties.title: Security Architecture Review
properties.body:
Meeting: Security Architecture Review
Date: 2026-06-08
Attended by: Diana Prince, Julia Roberts, Evan Wright
Notes: Evaluated database credential rotation. Diana Prince decided: Rotate all database passwords into Vault dynamic secrets to eliminate static credentials. System: Vault.

properties.title: Search Infrastructure Review
properties.body:
Meeting: Search Infrastructure Review
Date: 2026-07-14
Attended by: Alice Vance, Laura Croft, Carlos Mendez
Notes: Discussed orphaned Elasticsearch cluster. The original system owner, Marcus Aurelius, left the company on 2025-11-30. System ownership needs reassignment to Core Infrastructure.

properties.title: Container Platform Strategy

Meeting: Container Platform Strategy
Date: 2026-08-20
Attended by: Laura Croft, George Clark, Oliver Queen
Notes: Evaluated Kubernetes version lifecycle. Laura Croft decided: Standardize on Kubernetes 1.30 across all production regions to unlock gateway API controllers. System: Kubernetes.

properties.title: Developer Experience Sync
